content:
marta: Heads-up — prebake canary started failing around 23:07 UTC. Observed a KV-cache miss spike + increased p50 token latency.

sam: saw it. logs pointing to quant kernel fallback path, a few OOMs in the canary pool.

jess-qa: repro steps? I can run smoke on staging.

marta: minimal repro: run a 512->2k token generation with q4_0 model on canary pool. attach snippet.

sam:```
# repro load
ab -n 200 -c 10 "POST /v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-q4","input":"x..."}'
```

sam: metric snapshots: error_rate -> 1.9% -> spiked to 3.4% for 8m, p50 token time +40ms, p95 +200ms.

ops-bot: deploybot: pinned engine=quant-v3 to canary=off at 1742504380 :pushpin:

marta: thanks @ops-bot. proposal: holdship, reduce canary to 0.1% traffic, pin canary pool to previous kernel, start bisect builds.

olivia: agree holdship. Need release-note delta: mention "quant kernel revert for stability" and the rollback criteria.

jess-qa: I'll run targeted smoke on the pinned canary build and post traces. ETA 25m.

sam: bisect candidates: build 2024-06-20-07 (good), 2024-06-21-13 (introduced kernel ABI tweak). I'll prepare a reduced fixture.

tony-oncall: oncall FYI. If we exceed error_rate > 2.5% for 15m in prod we auto-roll back per SLO playbook.

marta: add explicit rollback trigger for this rollout: if p95 token time increases >150ms sustained 10m OR errors >2.5% 10m.

olivia: docship plan: update release notes + ops runbook section. Can we publish a short postmortem if we roll back?

sam: yes. I'll draft the notes with root cause hypothesis "quant kernel vector length edge-case causing KV cache thrash".

ops-bot: deploybot: reduced canary traffic to 0.1% at 1742504445 :arrow_down_small:

jess-qa: smoke results: pinned build looks stable at small load. No OOMs in 30m.

marta: ok hold for 1h. If no regressions, we decide to resume a staged rollout with 2% step slices and 15m observation windows.

olivia: assign: @sam to PR rollback checklist, @jess-qa to run expanded smoke, @marta to update release notes. I'll review.

sam: ack. starting bisect and will report candidate in #eng-runtime in 40m.

marta: @deploybot please annotate the release with: "holdship: canary reduced due to perf regressions; investigating quant kernel".

deploybot: annotation added to release 2024-06-22T23:10Z

tony-oncall: monitoring: added dashboard alert for kv_cache_miss_rate and canary_error_rate, paging threshold set at 2.5%.

marta: thanks all. keeping this thread for chrono. we will converge on whether to ship tonight by 00:30 UTC.

olivia: noted. update in 30m with bisect and smoke outcome. :hourglass:

sam: bisect found suspect commit abc123 (kernel change). reopening earlier kernel shows stable. prepping rollback CL.

jess-qa: expanded smoke passed on pinned kernel across 4 region-buckets.

marta: decision: do not ship current quant-kernel change. rollback scheduled and will patch release notes. rolling to full pin across canary pools at 1742504595.

ops-bot: deploybot: executed pin across canary pools at 1742504595 :white_check_mark:

olivia: filing short release-note entry and a follow-up erratum. thanks team.

marta: closing thread, will file postmortem draft in docs and link here once ready.
